decisions.reason: As an established custom earmold on its own webpage that fits the firm's core hearing-care portfolio and integrated-solution strategy, it is likely to remain in the range.
The vacuum thermoforming unit supports the firm's existing laboratory and production workflows and, having remained on the market after launch, would usually be kept unless demand weakened clearly.

Although presented on its own page, the orthopedic shoe last is outside the firm's main dental and hearing focus, so management would be inclined to reallocate resources back to better-fitting core activities and new developments.
The post-curing unit is close to the firm's digital manufacturing offer and supports its push into automated production, so it is worth retaining despite its still limited website prominence.
